# GAMbit Release Notes

- **New vertical page tabs:** All 29 pages with top-level tabs now display them down the left side, matching Settings. Tab counts, role restrictions, and help-desk visibility continue to work as expected.
- **Choose your preferred layout:** Restore horizontal tabs under **Settings & Updates → Appearance and safety → Page tabs → Across the top**. Changes apply immediately.
- **Nested tabs and dialogs:** Tabs within tabs—such as **Account / Email addresses / Security** under **Users → Manage a user**—remain across the top. Pop-up windows retain their existing layout.
- **Fixed update indicator:** The update notification dot now appears on the correct **Settings & Updates** entry, regardless of sidebar order or placement under **My pages**, and persists when the sidebar refreshes. This resolves an issue that incorrectly renamed **Ask GAMbit** and displayed duplicate Settings entries.
